name: Theodor W. Adorno
shortBio: Leading figure of the Frankfurt School; critiqued the culture industry, instrumental reason, and authoritarianism.
centralQuestion: How did Enlightenment rationality turn into its opposite: barbarism and mass conformity?

keyWorks.title: Dialectic of Enlightenment
keyWorks.description: Major work co-authored with Max Horkheimer diagnosing the dialectic of reason and the rise of the culture industry.

keyWorks.title: Minima Moralia
keyWorks.description: Reflections from damaged life examining the alienation of subjective experience under late capitalism.

keyWorks.title: Negative Dialectics
keyWorks.description: Critique of Hegelian affirmative synthesis, preserving non-identity and resisting totalizing conceptual systems.
